verdict.rationale: Codegen's core interaction model is prompt-driven: agents are run with natural-language prompts (e.g. agent.run(prompt="Leave a review on PR #123")) via SDK, API, Slack, and integrations, and can analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs from user prompts. This is well documented across docs/CLI/SDK but lacks independent hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation of natural-language command reliability, edge cases where prompts fail or need reformatting.
